package.description: A terminal file manager in the spirit of Midnight Commander.

en-US.author: dividebysandwich
en-US.description: A terminal file manager in the spirit of Midnight Commander.
en-US.longDescription: Rat Commander (rc) is a self-contained terminal file manager with modern features, staying true to the heritage of Norton Commander and Midnight Commander. It offers two panels with multiple view formats, full mouse support, and built-in tools that need no external programs: a viewer and editor with syntax highlighting, archive handling, FTP/SFTP/SCP clients, a disk explorer, a process explorer, a disk imager and a network monitor.
en-US.name: rat-commander (rc)
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's new
- Portable mode: if a file named portable sits next to the executable, all settings are kept in a config folder beside it instead of the platform config directory. The Windows .zip now ships with this marker, so it can run from a USB stick without touching %APPDATA%. Delete the marker to go back to normal. This works on Linux and macOS too (#20)
- New sort keys: change time, access time and birth (creation) time. The panel menu now has a Sort order submenu that shows the current key and toggles (#23)
- "Directories first" can now be turned off to sort folders and files together (#23)
- Symlinks to folders can now be entered and are sorted together with the folders (#22)
- Fixed a linking error when building on illumos and Solaris (#24)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/rat-commander/compare/v1.9.8...v1.9.9
Full Changelog: https://github.com/dividebysandwich/rat-commander/compare/v1.9.8...v1.9.9

zh-CN.longDescription: Rat Commander（rc）是一款自包含的终端文件管理器，传承 Norton Commander 和 Midnight Commander 的操作习惯并加入现代功能。它提供双面板和多种视图格式、完整的鼠标支持，并内置无需外部程序的实用工具：带语法高亮的查看器和编辑器、压缩包处理、FTP/SFTP/SCP 客户端、磁盘浏览器、进程浏览器、磁盘映像和网络监视。
